item.title: Brandie – Social Media Success SaaS (Lucknow Startup Overview)
item.description: Brandie is a Sweden-based innovative crowd marketing platform and the world’s first social media loyalty program, actively expanding its presence in India, including Lucknow. With 11-50 employees, Brandie empowers brands to engage their top 1% most loyal social media users by rewarding them for creating personalized content, thereby enhancing brand loyalty and authentic marketing.

item.title: Lucknow’s Beauty and Fashion Startup Scene: A Blend of Sustainability and Style
item.description: Lucknow’s beauty and fashion startup ecosystem is thriving with a focus on sustainability and traditional crafts. Key players like Greenwear Fashion and Astitva lead the way in eco-friendly textiles and conscious clothing, while numerous cosmetic manufacturers and beauty parlors offer a variety of products and services.

item.title: Bharat Startup Ecosystem Registry
item.description: The Bharat Startup Ecosystem Registry is a national initiative to identify, empower, and support rural and grassroots startups. It bridges the gap between rural innovation and urban opportunity by offering a digital platform for registration, mentorship, funding access, and growth tracking — ensuring India’s startup revolution includes every corner of Bharat.

item.title: Lucknow Startup Aims to Hit Sweet Spot with Natural Sugar Substitute
item.description: A Lucknow-based startup is creating waves by developing a natural sugar substitute that mimics the taste and texture of real sugar — without the health downsides. Targeting diabetic and health-conscious consumers, the innovation blends local ingredients with food-tech precision, promising a healthier, homegrown alternative to artificial sweeteners.

item.title: Lucknow-Based Superfoods Brand Keeros Raises Pre-Series A Round
item.description: Keeros, a Lucknow-based healthy superfoods brand, has secured an undisclosed pre-Series A funding round from Venture Catalysts. Known for its diabetic-friendly and nutrition-rich snacks, the brand plans to expand its product line, strengthen digital presence, and scale nationwide — positioning itself as a leader in India’s growing health food market.
